title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 6. Stresses that the legitimate fight against all forms of racism and discrimination, including anti-Muslim hatred, antisemitism and anti-Christian hatred, must be fully supported and protected from political instrumentalisation; rejects any attempt to criminalise or delegitimise anti-racist advocacy under the guise of security concerns;
